Class PropertySourcesPropertyResolver

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.core.env.AbstractPropertyResolver
org.springframework.core.env.PropertySourcesPropertyResolver
All Implemented Interfaces:
ConfigurablePropertyResolver, PropertyResolver
public class PropertySourcesPropertyResolver extends AbstractPropertyResolver
实现 `PropertyResolver` 接口，该接口针对底层的一组 `PropertySources` 解析属性值。
Since:
3.1
Author:
Chris Beams，Juergen Hoeller

    • logKeyFound

      protected void logKeyFound(String key, PropertySource<?> propertySource, Object value)
      Log the given key as found in the given PropertySource, resulting in the given value.

      默认实现会写入包含键和来源的调试日志消息。从 4.3.3 版本开始，为了避免意外记录敏感设置，该实现不再记录值。子类可以重写此方法来更改日志级别和/或日志消息，包括（如需要）属性值。

      Parameters:
      key - 找到的键
      propertySource - 在其中找到该键的PropertySource
      value - 对应的值
      Since:
      4.3.1
